loyaltyPrograms.title: Stamps vs Points: Choose Your Loyalty Program
loyaltyPrograms.description: Compare stamp cards and points programs for Apple Wallet and Google Wallet. A 60-second quiz finds the right fit for your café, restaurant, salon or shop.

home.title: Digital Loyalty Cards for Apple & Google Wallet | Stampeo
home.description: Your customers add your loyalty card to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet in one scan. No app to download, no card to lose. Ready in minutes.
home.keywords: loyalty cards, digital loyalty, Apple Wallet, Google Wallet, customer rewards, stamp cards

onboarding.title: Get Started
onboarding.description: Set up your digital loyalty card in minutes

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Get in touch with the Stampeo team. Questions about our digital loyalty cards? We're here to help.

design-de-carte.title: Custom Loyalty Card: Your Logo, Your Stamp Icons
design-de-carte.description: Your logo, your colors, your own stamp icons (background removed) or 98 ready-made ones. Build it in minutes, or send your logo and we make it in 24-48h.

scanner-mobile.title: Mobile Scanner: Add a Stamp in 0.8 Seconds
scanner-mobile.description: Scan your customer's card from the Stampeo app, with a haptic confirmation in 0.8s, or from any web browser. No hardware to buy, nothing changes at your till.

notifications-push.title: Lock Screen Notifications for Every Stamp
notifications-push.description: Stamp added, reward unlocked, milestone reached: every event sends an automatic notification to your customer's wallet. No extra app, no SMS cost.

analytiques.title: Loyalty Analytics: Who Comes Back, Who Drifts
analytiques.description: Real-time dashboard: daily scans, active customers, rewards claimed. Growth adds trends and peak hours. Pro adds 30-day retention and at-risk customers.

geolocalisation.title: Geofencing: Your Card Pops Up When They Walk Past
geolocalisation.description: When a customer walks near your shop, their loyalty card appears on their lock screen. No app, no Bluetooth, no location data collected. Coming soon on Pro.

campagnes-promotionnelles.title: Promotional Campaigns: The SMS Alternative
campagnes-promotionnelles.description: Send promotional broadcasts to your customers' Apple Wallet and Google Wallet, with no per-message fee. {growthBroadcasts} a month on Growth, unlimited and scheduled on Pro.

programme-fondateur.description: The Stampeo founding members program. All Growth features, available today.
